hero-violet.$description: Hero Violet — Primary action fills, active nav, link text, icon strokes, key borders — concentrated violet that signals interactivity and energy against the achromatic canvas

lavender-wash.$description: Lavender Wash — Soft section backgrounds, card fills, hover surfaces — barely-there violet tint that creates atmospheric depth without committing to color

lilac-bloom.$description: Lilac Bloom — Slightly stronger lavender for tagged surfaces, highlighted cards, badge backgrounds

periwinkle-veil.$description: Periwinkle Veil — Outlined action borders, soft decorative borders, glow/shadow tints — a mid-violet for quieter emphasis

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary headings, dominant body text, high-contrast borders, footer surfaces — the load-bearing neutral

carbon.$description: Carbon — Secondary headings, dark UI blocks, badge text on light fills

graphite.$description: Graphite — Input field text, subdued body text, card detail labels

iron.$description: Iron — Mid-tone icon strokes, secondary metadata, less prominent UI labels

slate.$description: Slate — Muted body text, helper text, placeholder text, tertiary labels

mist.$description: Mist — Input borders, disabled states, de-emphasized dividers

fog.$description: Fog — Hairline dividers, card borders, structural separators

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on violet fills, input fields

highlight-gold.$description: Highlight Gold — Accent surface for special callouts, limited-use highlight wash (badge spotlight or feature emphasis)

lime-pulse.$description: Lime Pulse — Green action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments

aurora-violet.$description: Aurora Violet — Gradient stops for hero washes and decorative banners

dm-sans.$description: UI and body workhorse. Weight 400 for body copy, 500 for emphasized text, 600 for subheadings, 700 for compact button labels. Neutral letter-spacing (normal) keeps long-form readable. Handles everything Saiga leaves behind — navigation, form fields, cards, tables, footnotes.

saiga.$description: Display and heading typeface. Custom geometric sans at extreme weights (800–1000) creates near-black slab headlines. Tight negative tracking (-0.002em to -0.008em) tightens letterforms at scale. Used only for marketing-facing headlines and the largest type moments — never for UI or body text.

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
